description.zh: 用最小干扰让已有账号用户进入系统的门面页：核心只有身份识别表单（邮箱/密码）与一个主按钮， 辅以第三方登录、忘记密码和注册入口。页面刻意保持极简——少一个字段，转化就高一分； 所有装饰都让位于"快点进去"这一目标。
description.en: The gateway page that gets existing users in with minimal friction: an identity form (email/password) and one primary button, supported by third-party login, password recovery and a signup link. Deliberately minimal — every removed field raises conversion, and all decoration yields to the single goal of getting in fast.

use_when.zh: 已有账号体系的产品的入口
use_when.en: Entry point of any product with an account system

use_when.zh: 回访用户需要快速恢复会话
use_when.en: Returning users need to resume a session quickly

use_when.zh: 需要对接 SSO 或第三方身份提供方
use_when.en: SSO or third-party identity providers are involved

avoid_when.zh: 新用户首次创建账号（用注册页承接）
avoid_when.en: First-time account creation — a signup page fits better

avoid_when.zh: 一次性工具、无需身份识别
avoid_when.en: Throwaway tools that need no identity

avoid_when.zh: 内嵌到弹窗的轻量验证（用模态登录更轻）
avoid_when.en: Lightweight inline auth — a modal is lighter

note.zh: 单卡片居中，最通用的默认形态
note.en: One centered card, the universal default

note.zh: 左品牌图 + 右表单，SaaS 常用
note.en: Brand panel left, form right — common in SaaS

note.zh: 先认邮箱再要密码，支持无密码流
note.en: Email first, password next — enables passwordless

note.zh: 第三方登录按钮置顶，表单退居其次
Logo 或品牌插画；分屏布局时占一侧，移动端隐藏。
note.en: Logo or brand art; takes one side in split layouts, hidden on mobile.

note.zh: 邮箱 / 用户名 + 密码，字段最少化，主按钮唯一。
note.en: Email or username plus password, minimal fields, a single primary button.

note.zh: OAuth 按钮置于分隔线下，与主按钮区分主次。
note.en: OAuth buttons below a divider, visually ranked below the primary action.

note.zh: 忘记密码、记住我等次要操作，弱化处理。
note.en: Forgot password and remember-me as de-emphasized secondary actions.

note.zh: 「没有账号？注册」放页尾，形成账号闭环。
note.en: A “No account? Sign up” link at the bottom to close the loop.

安全要求.zh: 中——会话与暴力破解防护

notes.zh: 居中卡片用 min-h-screen grid place-items-center；分屏变体 md 断点下 grid-cols-2， 左侧品牌区在移动端隐藏。表单字段用 autocomplete（username / current-password）， 密码框配可见性切换；错误信息内联展示并 aria-describedby 关联； 提交中按钮禁用防止重复提交。
notes.en: Centered card via min-h-screen grid place-items-center; split variant uses grid-cols-2 at md, hiding the brand panel on mobile. Fields set autocomplete (username / current-password); password gets a visibility toggle; errors are inline and linked with aria-describedby; disable the submit button while pending.

sources.name: Nielsen Norman Group — Login & Registration Forms

basic.zh: 创建一个登录页面，包含邮箱密码表单、第三方登录和注册入口。
basic.en: Create a login page with an email/password form, third-party login and a signup link.

design.zh: 创建居中卡片式登录页：品牌 logo、邮箱与密码输入（带可见性切换）、记住我开关、忘记密码链接、主按钮"登录"、分隔线下的两个第三方登录按钮、底部"没有账号？注册"。错误内联提示，提交中按钮 loading。
design.en: Create a centered-card login page: brand logo, email and password fields (visibility toggle), remember-me switch, forgot-password link, primary "Sign in" button, two OAuth buttons below a divider, and "No account? Sign up" at the bottom. Inline errors; button shows loading while pending.

implementation.zh: 用 React + Tailwind 实现登录页：受控表单 + 前端校验（邮箱格式、密码非空）， autocomplete 属性齐全；密码可见性切换；提交态禁用按钮； 错误 aria-describedby 关联字段；深浅色一致。不新增依赖。
implementation.en: React + Tailwind login page: controlled form with front-end validation (email format, non-empty password), full autocomplete attributes, password visibility toggle, disabled button while pending, errors linked via aria-describedby, consistent light/dark. No new dependencies.

agent.zh:
在当前项目中实现登录页。

先检查现有认证接口、路由守卫与表单组件，保持一致。
要求：
- 邮箱 + 密码表单，autocomplete 与内联错误提示
- 第三方登录按钮与注册入口
- 提交态防重复提交
- 深浅色一致，键盘可访问
- 不新增依赖
完成后运行现有检查，说明修改文件。
agent.en:
Implement the login page in the current project.

Inspect the auth API, route guards and form components first; stay consistent.
Requirements:
- Email + password form with autocomplete and inline errors
- Third-party login buttons and a signup link
- Prevent duplicate submission while pending
- Consistent light/dark; keyboard accessible
- No new dependencies
Run existing checks when done and list modified files.
